title: Elementals Additions
description: An addon for the elementals mod
body:
# This datapack changes a few things about the elementals mod.
**THIS DATAPACK SHOULD WORK IN MULTIPLAYER, IF YOU FIND ANY BUGS MESSAGE ME ON DISCORD (banos.ka) AND ILL TRY TO FIX THEM**

## Avatar cycle

When a player chooses an element for the first time, a random player is selected as the Avatar. If the Avatar dies, a new random player becomes the Avatar.
The Avatar is the only player who can use more than one element (not counting sub-elements).

## "Sub-bendings"

**YOU CAN ONLY USE THE SUB-BENDINGS OF THE ELEMENT YOU CHOSE AT THE START, THEY DONT HAVE AN UPGRADE SCREEN (because this is only a datapack), YOU USE THEM BY SELECTING THE CORESPONDING HOTBAR SLOT AND SNEAKING**

Lava bending (earth) - obtained by being level 50+ while not having the metal bending advancement and obtaining "Hot Tourist Destinations"

Combustion bending (fire) - obtained by being level 50+

Flight (air) - obtained by having two advancements: "Sky's the Limit" and "Great View From Up Here"
(use /tag @p add [lavabender/flight])

## Bending obtainment

When you first join a message will appear that will allow you to choose your element.
If this doesn't appear for some reason use **/trigger banosKa.chooseElement set [1-4]**
1-air, 2-water, 3-earth, 4-fire.

## Bending scrolls

You can fill an empty scroll by sneaking while holding it. It will turn into the scroll of the element you chose at the beginning, that way you can teach the avatar the bending style.
